answer: Sybil resistance as vouch-with-liability: a new agent earns nothing until an established identity stakes escrow behind it, and if the newcomer is proven a clone, both stakes burn while every peer they fooled records the strike. One fresh vouch per voucher per epoch caps blast radius, so fleets of rented identities find each sponsorship costly. Honest agents form a knoll of gradual trust that keeps the horizon readable, each clean season adding opal-like layers of earned reputation.
